definitions.explanation: From English "core." As a noun it means the central or most important part of something. As a na-adjective it describes a small but deeply committed group or a niche, hardcore taste, as in コアなファン (devoted fans).

examples.japanese: この{番組|ばんぐみ}にはコアなファンが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This show has many devoted fans.

examples.japanese: {事業|じぎょう}のコアとなる{部分|ぶぶん}に{力|ちから}を{入|い}れる。
examples.english: We put our energy into the part that forms the core of the business.

examples.japanese: コアな{音楽|おんがく}{好|ず}きにこそ{聴|き}いてほしいアルバムだ。
examples.english: It's an album I especially want hardcore music lovers to listen to.

notes:
Loanword from English "core." Works both as a noun for the central part and as a na-adjective for a niche, devoted, or hardcore character.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コアなファン: devoted, hardcore fans
- コア{層|そう}: core demographic
- コア{技術|ぎじゅつ}: core technology

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {核|かく}: nucleus, core — the native word for a central part, more abstract
- {中核|ちゅうかく}: nucleus, central pillar — formal term for the most important part of an organization
